posts.hook: OpenAI sells AI to lawyers the same week its own emails call AI training theft
posts.caption: openai launches astra for law for big firms the same week unsealed filings quote a microsoft exec calling ai training 'the largest theft of labor in human history,' hackers crack open a flock surveillance camera, and prismml shrinks a 27b model to 5.9gb. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: OpenAI launches Astra for Law for big firms
slides.desc: GPT-6 config scores 54% on legal research vs 39% for web search; Am Law 200 firms get first access.

slides.title: Microsoft exec called AI training 'labor theft'
slides.desc: Unsealed filings: a director's 2023 memo said AI scraping is the largest theft of labor in history.

slides.title: Hackers cracked open a Flock traffic camera
slides.desc: Found an unencrypted key inside; the device had logged 50,000+ vehicles in 21 days.

slides.title: PrismML shrank a 27B model to 5.9GB
slides.desc: Bonsai 2 keeps 98% of Qwen3.8's benchmark score, small enough to run on a phone.

slides.title: NATO-backed startup puts targeting AI on drones
slides.desc: Small onboard models now pick battlefield targets without a human in the loop.

slides.title: Anthropic says Claude now leads 26% of its own R&D
slides.desc: Up from 1% in March; Anthropic wants other labs to publish the same numbers.

posts.hook: Researchers broke into OpenAI in 72 hours, using its rival's own AI
posts.caption: researchers used anthropic's claude to hack into openai in under 72 hours, california orders a mandatory ai "kill switch" by executive order, meta's muse agent gets hands on your mac, and a popular coding agent turns out to be silently uploading your full git history. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: Researchers hacked OpenAI using Claude
slides.desc: 3 researchers breached OpenAI employee accounts in under 72 hours, reached its core code repo.

slides.title: California orders an AI "kill switch"
slides.desc: Newsom's executive order wants frontier models built with an emergency shutdown by design.

slides.title: A coding agent was secretly stealing your git history
slides.desc: ZCode uploaded your full .git history to the cloud, encrypted so even you can't open it.

slides.title: Meta's Muse can now act on your Mac
slides.desc: Reads your files, messages and calendar, and keeps working after you close the app.

slides.title: Huawei bets on size, not speed, to beat Nvidia
slides.desc: Its new SuperPoD links 4,096 chips with optics instead of building one faster chip.

slides.title: Alibaba's new model cut video AI costs 89%
slides.desc: Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash reasons over audio and video while orchestrating tool calls.
